To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
our proposed bandwidth-aware workflow mapping and scheduling algorithms perform better in terms of makespan than existing bandwidth-unaware workflow mapping and scheduling algorithm of Pegasus WSM.

the proposed bandwidth-aware scheduling of scientific workflows in Pegasus WSM is effective and can be applied to enhance the capability of Pegasus to schedule scientific workflows on Grid environments.

the proposed bandwidth-aware scheduling algorithms can reduce the makespan of scientific workflow application in a multi-site Grid environment by 10.8%, 12.2% and 14.6% as compared to the bandwidth-unaware algorithms.

the development of a workflow scheduling algorithm to improve performance of workflow applications by considering the bandwidth between sites.
improving the performance of scientific workflow applications in a multisite grid environment.
the development of a workflow scheduler, which enables the bandwidth-aware workflow mapping in a multisite environment.

our proposed bandwidth-aware workflow mapping algorithm is capable of improving the performance of workflow applications by reducing the data movement cost.
the proposed bandwidth-aware scheduling algorithms can reduce the makespan and improve the performance of the workflow application.
